note: stick04-levels-of-loud: levels shape, one narrator, 96 words. Facts: whisper ~30 dB, talk ~60 dB, +10 dB = 10x sound power, city traffic ~85 dB (hours of it damage hearing), rock concert ~120 dB (threshold of pain), Krakatoa 27 Aug 1883: ~172 dB measured 160 km (100 mi) away; heard on Rodrigues Island ~4,800 km (3,000 mi) away, where the police chief reported it as the roar of heavy guns.

lines.text: Five levels of loud, and level five was heard three thousand miles away.
Level one: a whisper in the park. Thirty decibels, barely a tickle.
Level two: talking, sixty decibels. Every ten more is ten times the power.
Level three: city traffic, eighty-five. Hours of that damages your hearing.
Level four: a rock concert, one hundred twenty. That's the threshold of pain.
Level five: in eighteen eighty-three, the volcano Krakatoa exploded.
It hit one hundred seventy decibels a hundred miles away.
Three thousand miles away, a police chief heard it and thought it was cannon fire.
